title: lespedeza juncea var. sericea
intro: Lespedeza juncea var. sericea, commonly known as Japanese clover, is a perennial legume native to East Asia. It has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including lowering cholesterol levels, regulating blood sugar, and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Japanese clover include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. These bioactive compounds contribute to the plant's ability to support cardiovascular health and immune function.
